justification: Image A shows schematic rock-art figures (stick-like humans, boats, animals) arranged loosely across a surface, while Image B shows a dense, registered composition of relief-carved rows of small human figures and hieroglyphic-style text in an organized grid; the only broad commonality is the presence of human figures, but their forms, groupings, and conventions differ entirely. The biggest difference is the presence of writing/text bands and tightly registered rows of figures in B, versus isolated schematic figures and boat motifs scattered on an open surface in A.
